description: This file defines a dynamic recipe detail page component for a Next.js application, including functions for static parameter generation and metadata, as well as the main React component that renders recipe details.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Provides static route parameters for prerendering each recipe detail page based on the recipes data.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Generates page metadata such as title and description dynamically based on recipe data.

methods.name: RecipeDetail
methods.description: The main React component for rendering the recipe detail page, including image, tags, timings, ingredients, and instructions.
